initialExam.title: RRB Technician 2026
initialExam.description: RRB Technician recruitment for Grade I and Grade III technician posts in Indian Railways workshops, maintenance depots, and production units across various trades.
initialExam.eligibility: 10th pass with ITI in relevant trade OR 12th with Physics, Chemistry, Math
initialExam.qualifications: Matriculation with ITI or 12th with Science
initialExam.syllabus: Mathematics (30Q), General Intelligence & Reasoning (25Q), General Science (30Q), General Awareness (15Q).
initialExam.examPattern: CBT: 100 questions, 100 marks, 90 minutes. Negative marking: 1/3rd.
initialExam.selectionProcess: CBT → Document Verification → Medical Examination → Final Selection
initialExam.jobRole: Technician Grade I/III in Railway workshops and maintenance facilities
initialExam.careerGrowth: Technician Grade III → Grade II → Grade I → Senior Technician → Master Craftsman.
initialExam.applicationProcess: 1. Visit rrbcdg.gov.in 2. Register 3. Fill form 4. Upload documents 5. Pay fee 6. Submit
initialExam.perks: DA, HRA, Transport Allowance, Medical, Free Railway Pass, Pension

ageLimitDetails.relaxation: OBC: 3 years, SC/ST: 5 years, PwD: 10 years
